def getScreenObjectSize(data, screenObject, maxWidth, maxHeight): from enigma import eLabel, eSize if isinstance(data, str): data = [(str(data), None)] font = screenObject.instance.getFont() size = eSize(maxWidth, maxHeight) width = max([eLabel.calculateTextSize(font, line[0], size, False).width() for line in data]) if data else 0 height = max([eLabel.calculateTextSize(font, line[0], size, False).height() for line in data]) if data else 0 return (width, height)
from enigma import ePoint, eSize, getDesktop screenSize = (getDesktop(0).size().width(), getDesktop(0).size().height()) iconPos = (10, 25) listPos = (70, 85) listSize = (720, 140) if self.list: scrollbarWidth = 25 # self["list"].instance.getScrollbarOffset() + self["list"].instance.getScrollbarWidth() height = 35 listLines = 4 listLines = len(self.list) newListWidth, newListHeight = getScreenObjectSize(self.list, self["list"], screenSize[0], screenSize[1]) newListWidth = max(listSize[0], min(screenSize[0] - 100, newListWidth + (scrollbarWidth if listLines > listLines else 0))) newListSize = (newListWidth, height * (listLines if listLines > listLines else listLines)) self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(newListSize[0], newListSize[1])) textAdjust = max(0, newListSize[0] - listSize[0]) else: textAdjust = 0 textPos = (95, 15) textSize = (1370, 65) maxWidth = textSize[0] + textAdjust + (0 if self.typeIcon else textPos[0] - iconPos[0]) newTextWidth, newTextHeight = getScreenObjectSize(self.text, self["text"], maxWidth, screenSize[1]) if newTextHeight > screenSize[1] - 100: maxWidth += 300 newTextWidth, newTextHeight = getScreenObjectSize(self.text, self["text"], maxWidth, screenSize[1]) newTextSize = (max(textSize[0], maxWidth), max(textSize[1], newTextHeight)) self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(newTextSize[0], newTextSize[1])) if self.typeIcon == 0: self["text"].instance.move(ePoint(iconPos[0], textPos[1])) if self.list: spacer = listPos[1] - textPos[1] - textSize[1] self["list"].instance.move(ePoint(listPos[0], textPos[1] + newTextSize[1] + spacer)) width = newListSize[0] height = newTextSize[1] + newListSize[1] + spacer elif self.typeIcon: width = textPos[0] - iconPos[0] + newTextSize[0] height = newTextSize[1] else: width = newTextSize[0] height = newTextSize[1] width += 70 height += 68 self.instance.resize(eSize(width, height)) self.instance.move(ePoint((screenSize[0] - width) // 2, (screenSize[1] - height) // 2))
